invalid_metric.method: single 75/25 time cut, no purge, no embargo; the scored model was then discarded and refit on 100% of the data, so no out-of-sample number described the deployed artifact

leakage_free_metric.method: purged embargoed 5-fold walk-forward, no refit on test

payload_note: The estimator is preserved in the .bak alongside this file; it is kept as evidence and must not be deployed.
why_a_code_switch_was_needed: Setting status to UNPROVEN in the model file lasted 150 seconds; a retrain rewrote it to USABLE. By 2026-09-16T19:49 the retrained AUC was 0.55, which clears the old 0.53 promotion bar, so without LEARNED_RANKING_ENABLED=False the model would have re-armed itself.
